description: Remove a previously-set name binding. If the name was not set (or was already forgotten), returns ok:true with found:false — forget is idempotent. Use when a named thing has changed: the object got moved or sold, a Sim left, a spot is no longer meaningful. Does not delete any memory beyond the name binding; see remember/recall for general memory.
call_signatures: cf $CF forget --name "the toilet"     # remove a name binding
common_mistakes: Forgetting a name you actually still want — forget is permanent within the session; you'll need to re-bind with name.
Trying to forget an ObjectID or a kind instead of the name string.
perception_hints: See current bindings before forgetting: list-names
